name: card-data-viz
title: CardDataViz
description: Standard data-visualization card chrome with variant-owned chart and legend composition.

intent.summary: Standard data-visualization card chrome with variant-owned chart and legend composition.
useWhen: A chart, legend, metric visualization, or custom data-viz composition needs standard card chrome.
Bar and line legends should remain static, or a donut and legend should cross-highlight without redundant donut tooltips.
A data-viz card needs a visible heading, optional filter action, and application-owned chart data.
avoidWhen: The card contains editable settings; use CardSetting.
The surface contains ordinary non-visualization content.
The application needs to replace the card chrome rather than compose its chart and actions.

alternatives.reason: CardSetting owns the controlled settings-section workflow.

accessibility: Provide a concise visible heading; the component renders it as a section heading.
Slotted actions must provide accessible names and controlled-state semantics.
Charts retain their own image names and data summaries.
A visible donut legend owns persistent labels and values, so donut mode suppresses the redundant slice tooltip.
states: Custom mode provides flexible body chrome and does not mutate chart or legend interaction.
Bar and line modes keep a slotted legend static by disabling hover emphasis.
Donut mode synchronizes active labels between chart and legend and shows chart tooltips only when no legend is present.
showFilter adds the standard filter action and emits dsFilterClick without owning filter state.
responsiveBehavior: The sm, md, or lg width sets a matching token-based minimum height and remains constrained by its parent.
The body allocates remaining height to the chart while legends retain content height.
Parent layouts own wrapping, stacking, and breakpoint-dependent card width.

customElements: Set variant to bar, line, or donut when the component should manage legend interaction; slot chart, legend, actions, and supporting content by name.
react: Keep chart data in React and pass chart, legend, and action elements through named slots.
angular: Keep chart data in Angular and project chart, legend, and action elements through named slots.

cardWidth.description: Width token with the matching data-visualization card min-height.

heading.description: Data-visualization heading shown in the card header.

showFilter.description: Renders the standard filter action before custom actions.

events.name: dsFilterClick
events.description: Emits when the standard header filter control is activated.
